## Environment
RelayDrop version, Node version, operating system and browser. If relevant, say whether this is Safari or a Home Screen web app.

## Steps to reproduce
Use a synthetic file. Include the expected behavior and what actually happened.

## Diagnostics
Include HTTP status codes or redacted errors only. Do not attach tokens, cookies, VAPID keys, push endpoints, private download links, control.json, identity registries or personal files.

For a suspected security vulnerability, follow SECURITY.md rather than posting an exploit publicly.
